title: Store-Wait Credit in Late-Delivery Disputes — Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts
content:
Time lost waiting at the store counter is credited when a late-delivery dispute is decided on Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts.

**Which batch.** The disputed violation's batch is the batch named on the late-delivery violation under dispute. Its waiting minutes come from the batch record in Cartwise Shopper Batches, and the free waiting minutes are those the Cartwise Shopper Batches schedule sets for that batch type.

**Clause.** The store-wait credit follows the waiting minutes recorded on the disputed violation's batch beyond the free waiting minutes of that batch type: an excess of 20 minutes or more gives a store-wait credit of 2 points; an excess from 10 minutes up to 19 minutes (one minute short of 20) gives 1 point; a smaller excess gives no credit.

| Excess waiting minutes | Store-wait credit |
|---|---|
| 20 or more | 2 points |
| 10 to 19 | 1 point |
| Under 10 | None |

## Worked readings (hypothetical figures)

A batch whose type allows, for illustration, 10 free waiting minutes:

| Waiting minutes recorded | Excess | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| 30 | 20 | 2 points |
| 29 | 19 | 1 point |
| 20 | 10 | 1 point |
| 19 | 9 | None |
